AGENT_RUN_NOT_FOUND: This run no longer exists, or you can't see its agent.
AGENT_RUN_NOT_RETRYABLE: This run can't be retried. Wait for it to finish, or retry the whole run.
AGENT_RUN_TURN_LIMIT: The agent made too many attempts without finishing, so the run was stopped.
AGENT_RUN_TIMED_OUT: The run took too long and was stopped.
AGENT_RUN_STEP_NOT_FOUND: This step isn't available. Step details are kept for 90 days.
AGENT_TOOL_FAILED: A tool the agent used returned an error.
AGENT_TOOL_TIMEOUT: A tool the agent used didn't answer in time.
